sections.content: You know impersonal *se* from B1 Unit 11 and *poder* from A1 Unit 10. This lesson uses them to say what is allowed: *se puede* + infinitive, *se permite* + infinitive and *está permitido* + infinitive. Use *poder* with a person when you say who may do it: *Puedes entrar por esta puerta.*

items.spanish: Se puede entrar por esta puerta.
items.english: You can enter through this door.

sections.content: Impersonal structures are useful when the rule applies generally rather than to one named person.
